contea di ritrovamento: East Riding of Yorkshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ IM CAE MAG[--]TIVS AVG ; R/ FELICITAS [REI] PVBLICAE

Copper alloy. Coin. Nummus of Magnentius (350-353), Felicitas Rei Publicae issue of 350-351, Reece period 18, probably Trier mint. Obverse description: Bullnecked bust draped and possibly cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: IM CAE MAG[--]TIVS AVG. Reverse description: Emperor standing left with labarum with Victory on globe in his right hand. Alpha in field right. Reverse inscription: FELICITAS…
